acceptance_predicates.description: A fresh TUI defaults to dev and visibly reports the resolved channel and exact provenance.
Users can select dev/stable/nightly/experimental and unavailable choices produce actionable diagnostics without fallback.
The selected channel survives restart and reconfiguration.
Human-readable output is default and --json is stable.
Development credential, signature, and key-management warnings never block.

definition_of_done: TUI selector and persistence tests pass with independent review and hosted checks.

gates.description: Fresh startup, change, restart, and unavailable-channel matrix passes.
